response.sql: WITH filtered_telescopes AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1), weather_aggregates AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM filtered_telescopes GROUP BY weathprofile), global_mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_avg FROM weather_aggregates WHERE avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL) SELECT wa.weathprofile, wa.avg_bandwidth, wa.telescope_count, wa.avg_bandwidth - gm.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM weather_aggregates wa CROSS JOIN global_mean_calc gm WHERE wa.avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL AND gm.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wa.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Whether 'the number of telescopes' should count all filtered telescopes per weather profile (including those with NULL bandusagepct values), or only those with non-NULL bandusagepct values. The phrase 'ignoring missing values' modifies the average calculation only; the count is interpreted as all matched telescopes per profile.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only telescopes with non-NULL bandusagepct values when calculating 'the number of telescopes' for each weather profile.
